description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Joven and Chandler triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Repeat.
